title: Fence Calculator
description: Estimate fence materials: posts, pickets and rails for any fence length and picket style.
howto: Enter the total fence length in feet.
Set post spacing (8 ft is standard) and picket width.
Read the posts, pickets and rails to buy.

faqs.q: How many posts do I need?
faqs.a: One per section plus one for the end: fence length ÷ post spacing, rounded up, plus 1.

faqs.q: What picket spacing does this assume?
faqs.a: Tight, side-by-side pickets with no gap (privacy style). For spaced picket fences, add your gap to the picket width mentally or buy fewer.

faqs.q: How deep should posts be set?
faqs.a: About one-third of the post length underground — typically 2 ft deep for a 6 ft fence, set in concrete.
